name: LooksRare
source: https://docs.looksrare.org/assets/files/LooksRare_Brand_Assets-58613b3d791f31eeedf46caf2c2d428c.zip (official LooksRare brand assets, files LooksRare Logo/icon-darkbg.svg, icon-lightbg.svg and icon-mono-black.svg)
notes: LooksRare renders identically to the official icon-darkbg.svg (#0CE466 with black and white; silhouette IoU 0.999), LooksRareFlat to icon-lightbg.svg (#04CD58; IoU 0.996) and LooksRareMono to icon-mono-black.svg in currentColor (IoU 0.996); each is a uniform scale (56/96) of the kit's 96-unit artboard onto the 64 grid
